runs.text:
Orden Ogan is a German power metal band with folk metal elements. The band was formed in 1996 by Sebastian Grütling and Sebastian Levermann. They currently have three demos and seven studio albums and are signed with Reigning Phoenix Music. Prior to 2024, the band was signed with AFM Records. They also organize the German metal festival WinterNachtsTraum.
